source.raw_text: Kyokoro Effect: The opppnent rolls 3 enekoro. Add 10 damage for each energy of the type that was rolled the most.
kyokoro_effect_text: The opppnent rolls 3 enekoro. Add 10 damage for each energy of the type that was rolled the most.

notes: Card identity, cost, printed damage, and visible effect text were transcribed from the supplied source.
Kyokoro outcome-orientation mapping and special-effect runtime encoding are intentionally deferred to the effect inventory / runtime pass.
Opponent-dice dynamic damage requires special runtime mapping.
Special card behavior is now explicitly represented in special_effects instead of being absent. Roll-sequence execution is intentionally pending.

10.7f: Psychic now rolls exactly 3 of the opponent's configured Enerkoro when the Kyokoro trigger succeeds. The most frequent energy count is multiplied by 10 and added to attack damage before Weakness.
10.7f1 official tie rule: all Energy types tied for the highest count contribute their full counts. Example Fire 1 / Grass 1 / Water 1 = 3 counted Energy = +30 damage.
